scope: LAST_CHANCE zero-training pipeline audit + defect repair before scientific re-run

findings.detail: G2 previously logged U_eq_gNA as overlay factorU vs factor(g*N*A), which is algebraically tautological. Now compares formal rel_usage_next to reconstructed g*N*A with relative tolerance 5e-3 (absolute 1e-4 is invalid once |U|~1e4-1e5 under float32/chunked scatter).
G2 correct_ga delta previously used trace_only rows as RAW baseline. Now uses explicit noop RAW rows and asserts trace_only does not change ranks.
BASE load did not actively unset QRTC_USE_MEMORY/QRTC_TOPK from os.environ after a RAW load in-process. Contract requires unset; apply_env now pops them.
Prior full run died on tqdm BrokenPipe during second dataset load under redirected logs. Force TQDM_DISABLE + patch tqdm.disable=True at load_solver/main.
DESIGN_CHECK abs_index is valid.txt line index; set_valid_line_indices maps to torchdrug absolute indices. Incomplete pre-audit run quarantined.
Repeated load_solver for mode switches caused cost/BrokenPipe risk; solver cache + set_last_chance_mode reused.

For DistMult fused path, U=sum_e mean_d |g*rho*h| factors as g*N*A under declared A/N definitions — so U≈gNA is expected identity (rel err <5e-3 under float32/chunked scatter), not independent empirical discovery. Investment hinge is behavioral freeze of g*A + D_check thresholds, not the identity alone.

Eval YAML had full_batch_eval=no with LNC num_negative=32, causing ~E/32 full Bellman-Ford passes per query side. Switched to full_batch_eval=yes for LAST_CHANCE eval-only configs; candidate universe unchanged (all entities), only chunking.

not_bugs: SOURCE_RESTORE import root enforced in load_solver
TEST not used for selection (D_design/D_check from VALID only)
Overlay does not modify SOURCE_RESTORE on disk
